svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="GwqKwnJCX7ggkVZ11151"> <mxGraphModel dx="1831" dy="991" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 Home[\"UniConnect Home\"] --> Catalog[\"Browse Course Catalogue\"]
 Home --> Login[\"Sign In\"]
 Home --> Signup[\"Create Account\"]

 Catalog --> Filter[\"Search or Filter Courses\"]
 Filter --> Join{\"Signed in as a student?\"}
 Join -->|No| Login
 Join -->|Yes| Enroll[\"Join Course\"]
 Enroll --> StudentCourses

 Signup --> AccountType{\"Account Type\"}
 AccountType -->|Student| StudentAccount[\"Enter Student Details\"]
 StudentAccount --> Login
 AccountType -->|Instructor / TA| Pending[\"Wait for Administrator Approval\"]
 Pending --> Approval{\"Approved?\"}
 Approval -->|Not yet| Pending
 Approval -->|Yes| Login

 Login --> Valid{\"Valid Credentials and Approved Account?\"}
 Valid -->|No| Error[\"Show Login Error\"]
 Error --> Login
 Valid -->|Yes| Role{\"Account Role\"}

 Role -->|Student / Representative / Course Head| StudentDashboard
 Role -->|Instructor / TA| InstructorCourses
 Role -->|Administrator| AdminDashboard

 subgraph Student[\"Student Workspace\"]
 StudentDashboard[\"Student Dashboard\"]
 StudentDashboard --> StudentCourses[\"My Courses\"]
 StudentDashboard --> StudentCalendar[\"Calendar and Deadlines\"]
 StudentDashboard --> ClassPages[\"Class Members and Announcements\"]

 StudentCourses --> StudentCourse[\"Open Enrolled Course\"]
 StudentCourse --> Materials[\"View and Download Materials\"]
 StudentCourse --> Assignment[\"Read Assignment and Deadline\"]
 Assignment --> Submission[\"Create Submission and Attach Files\"]
 Submission --> TurnIn[\"Mark Work as Turned In\"]
 TurnIn --> AwaitGrade[\"Await Instructor Grading\"]
 AwaitGrade --> Results[\"View Grade and Feedback\"]

 StudentCourse --> StudentDiscussion[\"Course Discussion\"]
 StudentCourse --> StudentNotices[\"Read Announcements and Vote in Polls\"]
 StudentCourse --> Delegated{\"Representative or Assigned Course Head?\"}
 Delegated -->|Yes| ManageContent[\"Manage Permitted Materials, Announcements and Events\"]
 end

 subgraph Instructor[\"Instructor Workspace\"]
 InstructorCourses[\"My Teaching Courses\"]
 InstructorCourses --> CreateCourse[\"Create Course or Join Teaching Team\"]
 CreateCourse --> InstructorCourse[\"Open Teaching Course\"]
 InstructorCourses --> InstructorCourse

 InstructorCourse --> PublishMaterials[\"Upload and Organize Materials\"]
 InstructorCourse --> PublishAssignment[\"Create Assignment and Deadline\"]
 PublishAssignment --> Review[\"Review Student Submissions\"]
 Review --> Grade[\"Enter Grade and Feedback\"]
 InstructorCourse --> PublishUpdates[\"Publish Announcements, Polls and Events\"]
 InstructorCourse --> InstructorDiscussion[\"Course Discussion\"]
 end

 PublishMaterials -.-> Materials
 PublishAssignment -.-> Assignment
 TurnIn -.-> Review
 Grade -.-> Results
 PublishUpdates -.-> StudentNotices
 PublishUpdates -.-> StudentCalendar
 StudentDiscussion <--> InstructorDiscussion

 subgraph Admin[\"Administrator Workspace\"]
 AdminDashboard[\"Administrator Dashboard\"]
 AdminDashboard --> Users[\"Manage Users and Roles\"]
 AdminDashboard --> PendingUsers[\"Review Pending Instructors\"]
 PendingUsers --> Approve[\"Approve Instructor\"]
 AdminDashboard --> Courses[\"Manage Existing Courses and Membership\"]
 AdminDashboard --> Statistics[\"View Website Statistics\"]
 AdminDashboard --> Administrators[\"Create Administrator Accounts\"]
 end

 Approve -.-> Approval

 StudentDashboard --> Profile[\"Edit Own Profile or Change Password\"]
 InstructorCourses --> Profile
 AdminDashboard --> Profile

 StudentDashboard --> Notifications[\"Check Notifications\"]
 InstructorCourses --> Notifications

 Profile --> Logout[\"Sign Out\"]
 Logout --> Home",
 "config": null,
